answer: Commit stake outputs before an unpredictable epoch beacon. Derive each ticket as H('mesa falcon comet', beacon, output ID). Validators count each locked unit once and keep it locked through voting. Selection weight is linear in an externally scarce asset: splitting 100 units across 100 keys gives the same total chance as one key holding 100. More aliases add no expected influence; more influence needs more locked capital. Sound randomness is required; rich coalitions remain powerful.
